paper.title: Self-Evolving Visual Concept Library using Vision-Language Critics (Escher)
paper.central_claim: Escher iteratively evolves a library of natural-language visual concepts: a VLM critic's label-free class-confusion signal guides an LLM, conditioned on a history of past proposals, to add disambiguating concepts, and the evolved library improves zero-shot, few-shot and fine-tuned concept-bottleneck image classifiers without human annotation.

signatures.object: Per-class natural-language concept library C (inputs to a concept-bottleneck classifier), initialised by zero-shot LLM queries; baseline is the fixed initial library of LM4CV / LaBO / Classify-by-Descriptions.
signatures.information: VLM (CLIP) image-class scores on validation images; no labels in the evolution step; LLM sees the confused class pair, their current concepts, and the pair's history; the test set is not used for evolution per the text.
signatures.operation: Refit adapter on current library; compute pairwise confusion r_ij (top-k confusion, correlation, clustering); sample K=50 pairs weighted by confusion with a repeat-decay gamma; LLM (gpt-3.5-turbo or Llama-3.3-70B) proposes disambiguating concepts for both classes with a scratchpad reason field.
signatures.output: 2-5 new concepts per pair unioned into the library; refit classifier.
signatures.conditions: VLM scores must carry enough signal to localise confusion (assumed calibrated); concept strings must fit the CLIP text context length.
signatures.feedback: Contrastive confusion between classes derived from VLM scores.
signatures.selection_rule: Pair sampling by confusion; concepts are appended unconditionally (no accept/reject, no pruning).
signatures.persistence: Library C_T (and adapter w_T) after T=60 iterations; reused for test-time classification of the same label set; history bank is run-local.
signatures.later_use: The refit classifier reads the grown library at every subsequent iteration and at test time; no reuse across datasets or label sets is shown.
signatures.claimed_effect: Fine-tuned LM4CV improves on all 7 datasets (CUB +19.9, Cars +6.9, CIFAR-100 +5.2, others under 2.1); zero-shot small gains; few-shot mixed.
signatures.failure_boundary: Poorly calibrated critic gives noisy iterations; few-shot overfitting; heuristic over-sensitive to minute errors; LLM concepts exceeding CLIP context halt the loop without a reasoning field.

signatures.object: Proposer context: history-conditioned prompt (per-pair record of earlier proposals and the confusion score after them).
signatures.information: Past concepts and subsequent confusion scores for the same class pair.
signatures.operation: Append history to the LLM query so it avoids regurgitating earlier concepts and sees which proposals did not resolve confusion.
signatures.conditions: Prompt length grows linearly with iterations.
signatures.persistence: Run-local datastructure; not persisted across runs.
signatures.later_use: Next time the same pair is sampled in the same run.
signatures.claimed_effect: History conditioning helps in most datasets (Table 6).
signatures.failure_boundary: No effect on Food101 and Flowers; cost grows with iterations.

gap.author_gap: Concept-bottleneck classifiers rely on fixed concept sets (manual or one-shot LLM) that lack discriminative power and ignore interactions; prior mutation approach is per-class and impractical beyond 20 classes.
gap.checked_gap: The fixed-concept-set object is clearly identified and the confusable-pair bottleneck is concrete. However, [5] already evolves concepts from classification feedback, so what is new is the label-free, pair-joint scheme; its advantage over [5] is argued but not measured.
gap.lineage: Classify-by-Descriptions (zero-shot LLM concepts) -> LaBO / LM4CV (learned adapters over fixed concepts) -> LLM-mutate [5] (per-class evolutionary refinement) -> Escher (label-free pair-joint evolution with history). Library learning from program synthesis (DreamCoder-style) is the stated inspiration. Neighbours cited, not available as fixed local sources.
gap.closest_adjacent: [5] LLM-mutate; LM4CV; LaBO; Classify by Descriptions.
gap.residue: Few-shot and zero-shot settings gain little; effect on label sets other than the evolved one is unknown.
gap.stakes: Concept quality bounds interpretable CBM accuracy, especially on fine-grained data (CUB, Cars).
gap.method_response: Target disambiguation concepts to confused class pairs using the VLM's own scores and an in-context history.
gap.remaining_gap: No head-to-head with [5]; the critic's marginal contribution beyond random pair selection is small in the authors' own ablations; no transfer or lifelong reuse of the library.
unresolved: Whether [5] under equal budget matches Escher could not be checked from fixed local sources.

rs_pattern.reason: The load-bearing move the paper claims is a label-free signal manufactured from the VLM's own scores (pseudo-confusion) that steers concept generation: self_supervised_signal_engineering/C07 (internal readout, small lever, frozen backbones). C07 step 5 (show the signal causally tracks the target) fails: Tables 6–7 put the critic's isolated effect at ≈0 (opus:O02). generative_process_redesign is not kept: its definition targets fixed internals of an iterative generative procedure (prior, endpoints, latent, conditioning granularity), while the concept library is the classifier's input vocabulary.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: Step 1 diagnosis localised to a structural site: present (missing discriminative concepts for confused pairs). Step 2 internal label-free readout valid under deployment assumptions: present but calibration assumed (E016). Step 3 confine correction to a small lever with frozen backbone: present (concept text plus linear adapter, frozen CLIP and LLM). Step 4 explicit stabiliser against collapse: partial (repeat-decay gamma, CLIP-length guard). Step 5 show the signal tracks the target by intervention: partial (random-critic ablation Table 7 and qualitative confusion-matrix comparison; critic effect small).
matches.success_failure_checks: Success: label-free signal manufactured from model scores; downstream metric reported. Failure: validity depends on calibration; internal signal's causal role weak once history is removed.
matches.reason: The VLM's own image-class scores are turned into a confusion signal that steers an LLM generator; frozen backbones, tiny lever. C07 preferred over C08 because there is no pseudo-label filter-retrain cycle for both components.

assessment.evidence_level_note: The concept library is evolved on validation logits and used on the test split; a count-matched LLM-concept control loses most of the gain (CUB 66.09 vs 83.17). Narrow: same classes, single run; heuristic chosen with test-set results.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: For fine-tuned LM4CV, growing the concept library by LLM pairwise-disambiguation queries raises test top-1 over the initial library and a count-matched concept control (largest on CUB, Cars, CIFAR-100). The VLM critic is not shown necessary (random pairs + no history ≈ critic + no history, opus:O02); zero-shot gains are small, few-shot mixed, and 'improves in every case' is contradicted by ties (opus:O04, opus:O05).
unresolved: Run-to-run variance (Food101 94.90 vs 94.97 for the same configuration).
